doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Mr. Tibbs, the church organist she studied by watching
summary: She learned from the Israel Baptist organist Mr. Tibbs by watching him; the Tibbs family appears again.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: If we can just return to the church for a minute, was there anyone else in the church who was instrumental in teaching you, or in showing you things, perhaps the choirmaster there?
He was the organist, and there was a family of Bobby Tibbs, Bobby and Peggy, and I was just right there in San Francisco, and the uncle came up and said something to me.
You mean later on when you played San Francisco?
Yes, okay. When you say right there . . .
Did he actually teach you, like formally sit you down and show you things, or was it more just getting what he was doing?
The organist at Israel Baptist Church? No, I studied him. I just watched him, you know, and then he let me sit in. He was beautiful.
